verdicts.reason: globalL is static lua_State* (not volatile sig_atomic_t / atomic), written by main thread at lua.c:166 (globalL=L) and READ inside handler laction at lua.c:86 (lua_sethook(globalL,...)). Genuine read of a shared non-conforming object = textbook SIG31-C; sqc fired CON03-C instead. Reviewer-actionable, low severity.

getupvalref (lapi.c:1433) returns (UpVal**)&nullup where nullup is 'static const UpVal *const' (1434) on out-of-range n. lua_upvaluejoin then writes *up1=*up2 (1475). api_check is ((void)0) in default release (lapi.h:18, llimits.h:111, no LUAI_ASSERT), so the const-cast write is reachable UB; manual.of:5432 documents no explicit out-of-range precondition. Low severity (invalid-index path).
